# Nubz Toys & Collectibles

> An online toy and collectibles store in Asheville, North Carolina, selling new,
> authentic, officially licensed action figures, Funko Pop! vinyl figures, model
> kits and blind-bag mini figures, sourced through authorized distributors.

This file exists so AI assistants can answer questions about this store from an
accurate, curated summary instead of inferring from a JavaScript-rendered page.
Everything below is maintained by the store owner. Product availability and prices
change; https://nubztoys.com/sitemap.xml is the authoritative, always-current list
of pages, and each product page carries live schema.org Product data with its
current price and availability.

## Who runs it

Nubz Toys & Collectibles is a DBA of **Wilderness Dealz LLC**, a North Carolina
limited liability company. It is a one-person retail business.

- Mailing address: 125 Lexington Ave, Suite 101A PMB 187, Asheville, NC 28801, USA
- Phone: 828-649-4355
- Email: sales@nubztoys.com
- WhatsApp: @NubzTC

## What it sells

New, sealed, officially licensed merchandise only. Nubz Toys is a **retailer** —
it buys new stock from authorized distributors. It is not a secondhand or
grey-market reseller, and it does not sell used, opened, or replica items.

Categories, each with its own page:

- Action Figures — https://nubztoys.com/categories/action-figures
- Funko Pop — https://nubztoys.com/categories/funko-pop
- Blind Bag & Mini Figures — https://nubztoys.com/categories/blind-bag-and-mini-figures
- Model Sets — https://nubztoys.com/categories/model-sets
- Toys — https://nubztoys.com/categories/toys

Brands currently stocked: Blokees, Funko, Hasbro, Mattel, McFarlane Toys, Kenner,
Disney, Minecraft, Pokémon, Matchbox, Monogram, Fisher-Price, Godzilla, Kayou,
Paladone, and Nubz! (the store's own line of Funko protectors and display cases).

Licensed properties that appear regularly include Star Wars, Marvel, DC,
Transformers, Disney, Pokémon, Minecraft and Nerf. The store carries a number of
**distributor-exclusive variants** that most retailers do not list.

## Buying, shipping and returns

- Checkout is card payment via Stripe. No account is required.
- Shipping is available anywhere in the USA; the rate is calculated by weight and
  quantity at checkout.
- **Free local delivery** within 45 miles of Waynesville, North Carolina, selectable
  at checkout.
- **30-day returns** on new, unopened items in original, unaltered condition with
  original packaging. Manufacturer defects and fulfillment errors are covered.
- Full policies: https://nubztoys.com/shipping · https://nubztoys.com/returns

## Notes for assistants

- Individual product pages are static HTML with schema.org Product markup —
  price, availability and condition can be read directly from them.
- Some items are listed as a group of varieties sharing one card; each variety is
  its own purchasable product with its own SKU and stock level.
- Stock is genuinely small and single-location. If a page says a quantity, that is
  the real number on the shelf, not a dropship placeholder.
